researcher_notes: Scope: Asia-Pacific and ASEAN peers. Method: official pages opened directly (ACRA, HKEX, FSA Japan, FSC Korea, KFTC, SC Malaysia, MEE China, gov.cn, SSE, ACMF, IDXCarbon, IFRS Foundation jurisdiction profiles). The PDFs of the IFRS profiles, the FSA roadmap, the Shenzhen Finance Bureau copy of the China Basic Standard annex and the SSE Guide No.4 docx were small (<350 KB) and text-extracted locally. The shared WebSearch budget for this run ran out partway through (after roughly 20 searches in this area), so India, Japan GX-ETS, Korea K-ETS, Korea's greenwashing provisions in the environmental technology law, Thailand's Climate Change Act, Indonesia TKBI/Perpres on carbon pricing, Singapore Article 6 deals and Asian enforcement cases could not be checked. They are listed in gaps or carried as UNVERIFIED leads with empty dates. Changes against docs/08-knowledge (A.5.5, 24/09/2026 snapshot): (1) The ASEAN Taxonomy is now Version 4 (ACMF, 6 Nov 2025), not v3. (2) Korea finalised its ESG disclosure roadmap on 8 Jul 2026: KOSPI companies with consolidated assets of KRW10tn or more report from 2028; Scope 3 is deferred to 2031+; there is a 3-year liability holiday except for intentional greenwashing. (3) Japan's Cabinet Office Ordinance amendment was promulgated and took effect on 20 Feb 2026, and it adds a Scope 3 safe harbour. (4) China's Climate Standard (Trial) was issued on 19 Dec 2025 and is voluntary until scope is set; nine industry application guides are out for comment until 26 Oct 2026, covering power, steel, coal, oil, fertiliser, aluminium, hydrogen, cement and auto. (5) Singapore deferred non-STI ISSB disclosures to FY2028/FY2030, made Scope 3 voluntary for non-STI companies and pushed assurance to FY2029 (25 Aug 2025). (6) Malaysia's ACSR published its non-compliance approach on 8 Dec 2025. Vietnam still has no IFRS Foundation profile or snapshot (page updated 24 Sep 2026). Date conflict to flag: China Basic Standard: the IFRS snapshot gives 20 Nov 2024 as the issue date, while Chinese media report public release on 17 Dec 2024. Both are recorded. The Japan IFRS profile (16 Jul 2026) cites FIEA amendments of 15 Jul 2026 mandating the JPY500bn tier; this could not be confirmed on the FSA site. Date convention: where a source gives only a year, key_dates encode it as YYYY-01-01 for a start-of-period obligation (e.g., 'FY2028' or 'disclose in 2028') and YYYY-12-31 for a 'by year X' target. The 'what' text always states the source wording, and no day-level date was inferred.
gaps: No Asian greenwashing enforcement case 2024-2026 with verbatim claim wording could be verified (search budget exhausted). Leads to research next: Korea KFTC/Ministry of Environment eco-friendly claim sanctions; Japan Consumer Affairs Agency measures orders on 'biodegradable' claims (Dec 2022, outside window); India CCPA notices; Hong Kong SFC/Singapore MAS ESG-fund actions; Taiwan FTC.

Korea: greenwashing provisions and fines under 환경기술 및 환경산업 지원법 (article numbers, fine amounts, 2024 amendment dates) not confirmed; law.go.kr text did not render. Final KSSB standards (KSDS) issuance date not confirmed; FSC 8 Jul 2026 release does not name them.
Japan GX-ETS: mandatory emissions trading from FY2026 under the amended GX Promotion Act could not be verified (METI site returned 403; GX League page silent).
Japan-Viet Nam JCM page (jcm.go.jp) could not be loaded; registered VN projects and credits are not verified.

India: SEBI BRSR Core assurance/value-chain changes (2025) and CCPA Guidelines on greenwashing (2024) could not be opened (SEBI listing has no ESG circulars on page 1; doca.gov.in TLS error; consumeraffairs.nic.in refused connection). Both are carried as UNVERIFIED leads with empty dates. India CCTS sector intensity targets were not researched.
Thailand: status of the draft Climate Change Act, the T-VER programme update and any final SEC Thailand ISSB rule after the June 2025 IFRS snapshot are not confirmed.

Indonesia: TKBI taxonomy versions, Perpres on carbon economic value (2025) and IDXCarbon launch and international-trading dates are not verified. OJK final SPK regulation status after the consultation closed on 13 Mar 2026 is unknown.

Singapore: carbon tax rates and eligible international carbon credits, Article 6 implementation agreements (whether Viet Nam is a partner) and any Singapore green-claims guidance (CCCS/ASAS) are not verified. The NCCS carbon-tax page returned 404.
ASEAN Common Carbon Framework: no official document found. The nearest verified item is the ACMF Voluntary Carbon Market Development Plan (Nov 2025).

China: the issue date and order number of 温室气体自愿减排交易管理办法（试行） (CCER measures) are not confirmed on mee.gov.cn. The final MOF Climate Standard notice text (财会〔2025〕34号) was not opened because the MOF site returned 502. The SZSE and BSE guideline numbers are not confirmed.
Hong Kong: FSTB roadmap and HKICPA HKSRS issue pages were not opened directly (facts via IFRS profile dated 12 Jun 2025). AFRC sustainability assurance framework status is unknown.
Malaysia, Thailand, Korea and Hong Kong IFRS profiles/snapshots are dated June 2025, so later changes may be missing.

items.title: IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards — Use by jurisdiction (jurisdictional profiles and snapshots)
items.title_vi: Hồ sơ áp dụng chuẩn mực ISSB theo từng quốc gia/vùng lãnh thổ (IFRS Foundation)
items.authority: IFRS Foundation (ISSB)

key_dates.what: Page last updated: 24 profiles listed (23 published, Oman forthcoming) and 13 snapshots
China, Indonesia and Chinese Taipei documents updated
Japan profile updated
Philippines profile updated

items.status_note: Living tracker, not law. Profiles cover jurisdictions with a finalised approach; snapshots are previews of proposed frameworks. Asia-Pacific profiles: Australia, Bangladesh, Hong Kong SAR, Japan, Malaysia, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Chinese Taipei. Snapshots: China, South Korea, Thailand, Indonesia. Viet Nam and India are not listed (checked 2026-10-13).

key_provisions.summary: Describe each finalised approach: which ISSB standards apply, to whom, from when, which transition reliefs were extended, and the assurance level. Each profile is prepared from a regulator questionnaire and reviewed by the regulator and audit firms.
Preliminary summaries of proposed regimes (China, Korea, Thailand, Indonesia). They may differ from final requirements.

claim_hooks: báo cáo theo IFRS S1 và IFRS S2 / prepared in accordance with IFRS S1 and S2
phù hợp chuẩn mực ISSB / aligned with ISSB Standards
tuân thủ TCFD / TCFD-aligned

public_data.name: IFRS Foundation use-by-jurisdiction page
public_data.what: Checks whether a parent's or peer's home jurisdiction actually requires ISSB-based reporting in the year a VN report says it does

items.evidence_note: Page opened 2026-10-13: 'Last updated 24 September 2026'. The list of profiles and snapshots and the absence of Viet Nam and India were read from the page. Profile PDFs for SG, JP, HK, MY, PH, TW and snapshots for CN, KR, TH, ID were opened and text-extracted.
items.relevance_why: A VN report that claims 'ISSB-aligned' or cites a foreign parent's mandate can be dated against this tracker. It also documents that VN has no ISSB mandate, so 'theo chuẩn mực ISSB' in a VN report is voluntary and needs a stated basis of preparation.
items.caveats: This is a secondary compilation for individual jurisdictions. Bind rules only to the regulator text (items below).

items.title: Extended Timelines for Most Climate Reporting Requirements to Support Companies (ACRA and SGX RegCo joint release)
items.title_vi: Singapore gia hạn lộ trình báo cáo khí hậu (ACRA và SGX RegCo, 25/08/2025)
items.authority: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) and Singapore Exchange Regulation (SGX RegCo)

key_dates.what: FY2025: Scope 1 and 2 GHG reporting mandatory for ALL listed issuers; STI constituents also report other ISSB-based climate disclosures
FY2026: Scope 3 mandatory for STI constituents only; voluntary 'until further notice' for non-STI issuers
FY2028: non-STI issuers with market cap of S$1bn or more start other ISSB-based climate disclosures
FY2029: external limited assurance of Scope 1 and 2 for all listed issuers (deferred)
FY2030: non-STI issuers below S$1bn start other ISSB-based disclosures; large non-listed companies (revenue of S$1bn or more and assets of S$500m or more) start reporting, with legislation to come
FY2032: limited assurance of Scope 1 and 2 for large non-listed companies

items.status_note: Scope 1 and 2 reporting is in force for FY2025 under the SGX Mainboard/Catalist Rules and Practice Notes 7.6/7F. The other phases are postponed. The IFRS Singapore profile (updated 26 Jun 2026) confirms the August 2025 timelines.

key_provisions.summary: 'Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions reporting will remain mandatory for all listed companies from FY2025.' Scope 3 is voluntary until further notice for non-STI issuers.

'External limited assurance for Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions is deferred to FY2029 for all listed companies.' The IFRS profile adds that assurance may use the Singapore equivalent of ISSA 5000 (or ISO 14064-3).
ISSB-based climate disclosures, including Scope 1 and 2, are deferred to FY2030, with assurance from FY2032.

claim_hooks: phát thải phạm vi 1 và 2 đã được đảm bảo độc lập / Scope 1 and 2 emissions externally assured
phát thải phạm vi 3 / Scope 3 emissions
báo cáo khí hậu theo ISSB / ISSB-based climate reporting

public_data.name: ACRA joint release 25 Aug 2025
public_data.what: Dates the phases. A non-STI parent's 'Scope 3 disclosed' or 'assured' claim before FY2029 is voluntary and needs its own evidence

items.evidence_note: ACRA page id/887 opened: title, date 25 Aug 2025, the tier table and the quoted sentences. The IFRS SG profile (26 Jun 2026) confirms the tiers, the large non-listed company definition and the FY2029/FY2032 assurance dates.
items.relevance_why: Many SGX-listed groups own VN subsidiaries (real estate, F&B, logistics). Their FY2025 Scope 1 and 2 must include VN operations within the consolidated boundary, so VN figures can be cross-checked against the parent's SGX report. An 'assured' claim before FY2029 is voluntary.
items.caveats: This is a joint announcement. The binding text is the SGX Listing Rules and Practice Notes, which were not opened.

items.title: 企業内容等の開示に関する内閣府令及び特定有価証券の内容等の開示に関する内閣府令の一部を改正する内閣府令
items.title_vi: Sắc lệnh Nội các sửa quy định công bố thông tin doanh nghiệp: bắt buộc áp dụng chuẩn mực SSBJ trong báo cáo chứng khoán thường niên (Nhật Bản)
items.authority: Financial Services Agency (FSA), Cabinet Office of Japan

key_dates.what: FSA 'Japanese Roadmap on Sustainability Disclosure and Assurance' released (updated April 2026)
Ordinance promulgated and in force; disclosure guideline B 5-16-2 (Scope 3 safe harbour) applies from this date
FY ending March 2027: mandatory SSBJ disclosure for TSE Prime companies with 5-year average market cap of JPY3tn or more
FY ending March 2028: JPY1tn or more; mandatory limited assurance starts for the JPY3tn tier (one year after application)
FY ending March 2029: JPY500bn-1tn tier per FSA roadmap; the IFRS profile says FIEA amendments of 15 Jul 2026 mandated it (not confirmed on FSA site)

items.status_note: In force since 20 Feb 2026. The substantive SSBJ obligations start with fiscal years ending on or after 31 Mar 2027 (JPY3tn tier), and early application is allowed. Mandatory assurance is not in this ordinance; it is set out in the FSA roadmap.

key_provisions.summary: TSE Prime companies with average market cap of JPY1tn or more (average of the last 5 fiscal year-ends) must include SSBJ-based sustainability information in the annual securities report. The JPY3tn tier starts one year earlier.
The FSA designates the SSBJ standards by public notice. The revised SSBJ standards of 13 Mar 2026 were put to consultation for designation (FSA Weekly Review No.682).
Two-step filing: in the first two years, SSBJ information may be filed by amendment report up to the next semi-annual report deadline.
Scope 3 safe harbour: no liability for false or misleading Scope 3 figures if the estimation process and the reasons for differences are reasonably and specifically described.

claim_hooks: phát thải phạm vi 3 ước tính / estimated Scope 3 emissions
tuân thủ chuẩn mực SSBJ / prepared in accordance with SSBJ Standards
thông tin hướng tới tương lai / forward-looking information

public_data.name: EDINET (FSA electronic disclosure)
public_data.what: Annual securities reports of Japanese parents. Cross-checks VN subsidiaries' emissions, targets and 'parent-verified' claims

items.evidence_note: FSA release 20260220 opened: title, 'promulgated and in force today' (本日付で公布・施行), JPY1tn and JPY3tn tiers, B 5-16-2 safe harbour and two-step filing. FSA roadmap PDF text-extracted: 'Released January 8, 2026'; tiers 3tn/1tn/500bn for FY ending Mar 2027/2028/2029; assurance one year after application; limited scope for the first two years. Article numbers 19-9 and Supplementary Art. 2(2) come from the EY Japan summary (secondary) and FSA Weekly 682 (Art. 19-9(5)).
items.relevance_why: Japanese groups are major investors and buyers in VN. Their Scope 3 and supplier data requests and their parent-level figures can be compared with VN subsidiary claims. The Scope 3 safe harbour shows what a reasonable estimation disclosure looks like, which is useful as a label convention for 'estimated' figures.
items.caveats: The ordinance number is reported in secondary sources as 令和8年内閣府令第5号. It was not confirmed on the FSA page, so document_number is left empty.

items.title: SSBJ Sustainability Disclosure Standards (Application Standard, General Disclosures Standard, Climate-related Disclosures Standard)
items.title_vi: Bộ chuẩn mực công bố thông tin bền vững của Nhật Bản (SSBJ), dựa trên IFRS S1/S2
items.authority: Sustainability Standards Board of Japan (SSBJ)

key_dates.what: Three standards issued (Application, General, Climate)
SSBJ revised the standards; FSA consulted on designating them under Art. 19-9(5) (31 Mar 2026)
SSBJ issued a practical standard on using data from Japan's GHG reporting system (温対法) when applying the climate standard

items.status_note: Issued and designated for use. Mandatory only through the FSA ordinance for TSE Prime tiers from FY ending March 2027, and voluntary for others.

key_provisions.summary: Mirrors IFRS S2: governance, strategy, risk management, metrics and targets, including Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions. The 2026 practical standard allows use of statutory GHG reporting-system data.
Aligned with the core content of IFRS S1 (sustainability-related risks and opportunities).

claim_hooks: theo chuẩn mực SSBJ / SSBJ-compliant
số liệu KNK theo chế độ báo cáo bắt buộc của Nhật / GHG data under Japan's mandatory GHG reporting system
items.evidence_note: The FSA roadmap PDF states the SSBJ Standards 'were developed in March 2025'. FSA Weekly 682 confirms the 13 Mar 2026 revision. The SSBJ site news list shows the 11 Jun 2026 practical standard. The exact day 5 Mar 2025 and the three standard names come from Linklaters (secondary).
items.relevance_why: This is mainly the reference standard behind the Japanese mandate. It matters for VN subsidiaries reporting to Japanese parents.
items.caveats: The Japanese titles of the three standards were not verified, so the title is given in English.

items.title: 企业可持续披露准则——基本准则（试行）
items.title_vi: Chuẩn mực công bố thông tin bền vững doanh nghiệp — Chuẩn mực cơ bản (thí điểm), Trung Quốc
items.authority: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance) jointly with other ministries (外交部, 发展改革委, 工业和信息化部, 生态环境部, 商务部, 中国人民银行, 国务院国资委, 金融监管总局, 中国证监会)

key_dates.what: Public release reported by Chinese media (Yicai, CS.com.cn)
MOF released Application Guidance for the Basic Standard (per IFRS snapshot)
MOF target: Basic Standard, Climate Standard and application guidance in place by 2027; unified system 'basically established' by 2030

items.status_note: Voluntary. Per the IFRS China snapshot (18 Jun 2026), 'Until the implementation scope and requirements are specified, entities may apply the standards voluntarily'. The plan is to move from listed to non-listed companies and from voluntary to mandatory.

key_provisions.summary: The reporting entity for sustainability information must be the same as the financial-statement entity.
Materiality covers both financial materiality (risks and opportunities) and impact materiality (severity, scale, scope, irremediability and likelihood of impacts).
Material information must not be obscured by immaterial information or by aggregating dissimilar items. Material prior-period errors must be disclosed and corrected.
Reliability means complete, neutral and accurate: 'neutral' requires disclosure without bias, '不低估或者夸大信息' (neither understating nor exaggerating).
Information must be verifiable from the information itself or its inputs. Independent assurance statements are encouraged.
The sustainability report is published at the same time as the financial statements unless regulators provide otherwise.

claim_hooks: thông tin trung lập, không phóng đại / neutral, not exaggerated (不低估或者夸大)
trọng yếu kép / double materiality (双重重要性)
đảm bảo độc lập báo cáo bền vững / independent assurance statement (鉴证声明)
items.evidence_note: Annex text read from the Shenzhen Finance Bureau copy (government portal, PDF created 2024-12-16): Arts. 2, 5, 9, 10, 12, 15 and 30 quoted. The 20 Nov 2024 issue date comes from the IFRS China snapshot; the 17 Dec 2024 release date and the document number 财会〔2024〕17号 come from media (secondary). kjs.mof.gov.cn returned 502.
items.relevance_why: Art. 12's 'neutral, neither understating nor exaggerating' and Art. 10's 'no obscuring' are a clean regulatory statement of anti-greenwashing quality criteria, usable as a label convention. It also applies to Chinese-invested companies in VN (steel, textiles, solar) whose parents report under it.
items.caveats: Date conflict: 20 Nov 2024 (IFRS snapshot, likely the date of the notice) versus 17 Dec 2024 (media, public release). The Shenzhen copy is the annex only, without the notice header, so effective_from is unknown and left empty.

items.title: 企业可持续披露准则第1号——气候（试行）
items.title_vi: Chuẩn mực công bố thông tin bền vững doanh nghiệp số 1 — Khí hậu (thí điểm), Trung Quốc
items.authority: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance) jointly with eight other ministries

key_dates.what: Exposure draft (财会〔2025〕17号) issued by MOF with Ministry of Ecology and Environment (secondary)
Final Climate Standard (Trial) issued (IFRS snapshot)
Comment deadline for the Climate Standard application guide and nine industry guides (see CN-MOF-CLIMATE-INDUSTRY-GUIDES-ED-2026)

items.status_note: Voluntary until MOF and regulators set the scope (IFRS snapshot 18 Jun 2026). Its first mandatory use would come through regulators or exchanges.

key_provisions.summary: Six parts: general provisions, governance, strategy, risk and opportunity management, metrics and targets, and supplementary provisions (secondary).

Climate impact information must not obscure risk and opportunity information. Where climate impact information is also disclosed through legally required environmental disclosure channels, it must be consistent across all disclosures.
The ED required absolute gross Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions. Final wording not verified.

claim_hooks: số liệu khí hậu nhất quán giữa các kênh công bố / consistent across legally required environmental disclosures
phát thải phạm vi 1, 2, 3 / Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions (范围一、二、三)
items.evidence_note: Issue date 19 Dec 2025, voluntary status and the cross-channel consistency rule come from the IFRS China snapshot (updated 18 Jun 2026), which cites MOF notices. The document number 财会〔2025〕34号 is cited in a 30 Sep 2026 news report on the MOF exposure drafts. The MOF site was unreachable (502).
items.relevance_why: The cross-channel consistency rule mirrors a GreenScan check: the same metric must match between the sustainability report and statutory environmental reports. It is also the template Chinese parents of VN steel, cement and solar firms will use.
items.caveats: The final MOF notice was not opened. Confirm the document number and any effective date from MOF before binding.

items.title: 《企业可持续披露准则第1号——气候（试行）》应用指南（征求意见稿）及电力等9个行业应用指南（征求意见稿）
items.title_vi: Dự thảo hướng dẫn áp dụng chuẩn mực Khí hậu và 9 hướng dẫn ngành (điện, thép, than, dầu khí, phân bón, nhôm, hydro, xi măng, ô tô), Trung Quốc
items.authority: 财政部办公厅 (General Office, Ministry of Finance)

key_dates.what: Exposure drafts issued (reported)
Comment deadline (反馈截止)

items.status_note: Open for comment as of 2026-10-13.

key_provisions.summary: Nine industry guides: 电力、钢铁、煤炭、石油、化肥、铝、氢、水泥、汽车 (power, steel, coal, petroleum, fertiliser, aluminium, hydrogen, cement, automobiles), plus a general application guide.

claim_hooks: cường độ phát thải trên tấn thép / tấn xi măng / emissions intensity per tonne of steel or cement
điện tái tạo / renewable electricity
hydro xanh / green hydrogen
items.evidence_note: The 30 Sep 2026 news report quotes the industry list '电力、钢铁、煤炭、石油、化肥、铝、氢、水泥、汽车9个行业' and the deadline '意见反馈截止时间为2026年10月26日'. The 28 Sep 2026 date comes from a search summary. The MOF page was not opened.
items.relevance_why: The sector list matches GreenScan's high-emission collection plan (power, steel, cement, oil and gas, fertiliser, auto). Once final, these guides give sector-specific metric expectations, a ready-made 'expected indicators' set for selective-disclosure checks in VN reports from the same sectors.
items.caveats: Draft. Collect the PDFs once MOF publishes the final versions (expected after 26 Oct 2026).

items.title: 上海证券交易所上市公司自律监管指引第14号——可持续发展报告（试行）（及深圳、北京证券交易所同类指引）
items.title_vi: Hướng dẫn tự quản của SSE/SZSE/BSE về báo cáo phát triển bền vững (thí điểm), Trung Quốc
items.authority: 上海证券交易所, 深圳证券交易所, 北京证券交易所 (Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing Stock Exchanges)

key_dates.what: Guidelines take effect (SZSE version: 6 chapters, 63 articles)
SSE publishes guides No.1 (general requirements and framework) and No.2 (climate)
First mandatory sustainability reports for FY2025 due: SSE 180 and STAR 50 constituents, SZSE 100 and ChiNext Index constituents, and A+H/dual-listed companies

items.status_note: The first mandatory reports (FY2025) were due by 30 Apr 2026. Per the exchanges, qualitative disclosure of financial effects is allowed for 2025-2026. Other listed companies are encouraged to report voluntarily.

key_provisions.summary: '报告期内持续被纳入深证100、创业板指数样本公司，及境内外同时上市的公司最晚可在2026年4月30日前首次披露2025年度《可持续发展报告》'. The SSE equivalent covers SSE 180 and STAR 50 constituents and dual-listed companies.
Double materiality and four elements (governance, strategy, impact/risk/opportunity management, metrics and targets). Climate topic with Scope 1, 2 and 3 accounting guidance in SSE Guide No.2.

claim_hooks: trung hòa các-bon / carbon neutrality (碳中和)
phát thải phạm vi 3 / Scope 3 (范围三)
báo cáo phát triển bền vững bắt buộc / mandatory sustainability report

public_data.name: CNINFO (CSRC-designated disclosure platform)
public_data.what: FY2025 sustainability reports of Chinese steel, cement, power and solar peers and parents. Gives benchmark intensities and cross-checks for Chinese-invested VN companies

items.evidence_note: CS.com.cn (12 Apr 2024) opened: effective '5月1日', '6章63条', and the 2026-04-30 clause quoted (SZSE). The SSE scope (180/STAR 50) and the Jan 2025 guides come from search summaries of Yicai and SSE pages. The SSE drafting note docx was opened (confirms Guides No.1 and No.2 and Scope 1/2/3 guidance). The SSE Guideline No.14 text itself was not opened (404 or timeout).
items.relevance_why: The first wave of mandatory Chinese sustainability reports (2026) is a large free corpus of sector peers. Chinese parents of VN plants must cover them within the consolidated entity.
items.caveats: The SZSE and BSE guideline numbers were not verified. Confirm the exact SSE scope wording from the SSE rule text.

items.title: 上海证券交易所上市公司自律监管指南第4号——可持续发展报告编制（2026年1月修订）
items.title_vi: Hướng dẫn số 4 của SSE về lập báo cáo phát triển bền vững (sửa đổi 01/2026): bổ sung phụ lục phát thải chất ô nhiễm, năng lượng, nước
items.authority: 上海证券交易所 (Shanghai Stock Exchange)
items.status_note: Revised January 2026; Art. 6: '本指南自发布之日起施行' (effective on issuance). The exact day in January 2026 was not confirmed.

key_provisions.summary: Sustainability reports must be true, accurate and complete. Companies bear legal liability where disclosure contains '虚假记载、误导性陈述或者重大遗漏' (false records, misleading statements or material omissions).
No.1 general requirements and framework; No.2 climate; and new in the 2026 revision: No.3 pollutant emissions (污染物排放), No.4 energy use (能源利用), No.5 water use (水资源利用).
Companies are encouraged to follow the annexes' disclosure points and may use the sample texts. The guide adds no new mandatory requirements beyond Guideline No.14.

claim_hooks: tuyên bố gây hiểu nhầm, bỏ sót trọng yếu / misleading statements or material omissions (误导性陈述或者重大遗漏)
tiêu thụ năng lượng / energy use
sử dụng nước / water use
phát thải chất ô nhiễm / pollutant emissions
items.evidence_note: SSE docx (13.6 KB) text-extracted: heading '（2026年1月修订）', Arts. 1-6 and the annex list (Nos. 1-5) read directly.
items.relevance_why: The new topical annexes (pollutants, energy, water) match TT 96 Annex IV items 6.3-6.4 and the VN environmental-report fields, so they serve as a peer template for 'expected indicators'. Art. 4 states the misleading/omission standard plainly.
items.caveats: The annex texts themselves were not opened; only their titles were. The day of issue is unknown.

items.title: 全国碳排放权交易市场覆盖钢铁、水泥、铝冶炼行业工作方案
items.title_vi: Phương án mở rộng thị trường carbon quốc gia Trung Quốc sang thép, xi măng, luyện nhôm
items.authority: 生态环境部 (Ministry of Ecology and Environment)

key_dates.what: Work plan released with MEE official Q&A
Xinhua reports the MEE allocation plan for power (2025, 2026) and steel, cement and aluminium (2026); allocation method for the three sectors unchanged from 2025
'Deepening' phase starts; MEE to study a predictable mechanism to tighten sector allocation totals from 2027

items.status_note: Launch phase covers 2024-2026. For 2024, allocations equalled verified emissions (no shortfall or compliance cost). 2025-2026 allocations are roughly balanced per sector, using adjustment factors.

implements: 碳排放权交易管理暂行条例 (Interim Regulations on the Administration of Carbon Emissions Trading)

key_provisions.summary: About 1,500 new key emitting units and about 3 bn t CO2e added; the national ETS then covers more than 60% of national CO2 emissions. Gases: CO2 for steel and cement; CO2, CF4 and C2F6 for aluminium smelting.
Intensity-based, output-linked free allocation rather than an absolute cap.

Six sector-specific accounting, reporting and verification guidelines. Monthly recording of key parameters, annual emission reports and technical review by qualified service providers. National, provincial and municipal three-level data review.

claim_hooks: cường độ phát thải trên tấn clinker / tấn thép / emissions intensity per tonne of clinker or steel
dư hạn ngạch / allowance surplus
đã thẩm định số liệu phát thải / verified emissions data
items.evidence_note: MEE Q&A page (2025-03-26) opened: sectors, ~1,500 entities, ~3 bn t, >60%, gases, phases, 2024 allocation equal to verified emissions, MRV design, and the 2027 tightening study. The 2026 allocation plan comes from Xinhua (2026-09-03). MEE interpretation No.20 (2025-11-25) adds that lime, ceramics and flat glass are not yet covered.
items.relevance_why: VN's pilot ETS (QĐ 263/QĐ-TTg; NĐ 29/2026) covers the same kind of facilities (thermal power, steel, cement) with intensity-style allocation. China's design and data are a comparator for VN claims such as 'đạt hạn ngạch' or 'cường độ phát thải thấp hơn ngành', and for Chinese-owned VN plants.
items.caveats: The work plan's own document number (环气候…) was not confirmed. The page opened is the official Q&A, not the plan text.

items.title: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅关于推进绿色低碳转型加强全国碳市场建设的意见
items.title_vi: Ý kiến của Văn phòng Trung ương Đảng và Văn phòng Quốc vụ viện về tăng cường xây dựng thị trường carbon toàn quốc (2025)
items.authority: 中共中央办公厅, 国务院办公厅 (General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council)

key_dates.what: Published (Xinhua, via gov.cn)
Target: ETS basically covers major industrial emitting sectors; CCER covers key fields fully; absolute caps first for sectors with stable emissions
Target: ETS based on total allowance caps, with free and paid allocation combined

items.status_note: Policy opinion (party and state). Implemented through MEE rules and allocation plans.

key_provisions.summary: '到2027年，全国碳排放权交易市场基本覆盖工业领域主要排放行业…' and '到2030年，基本建成以配额总量控制为基础、免费和有偿分配相结合的全国碳排放权交易市场'.
Improve CCER offset rules and raise international recognition ('完善核证自愿减排量抵销规则，提高国际认可度'). Encourages government bodies and SOEs to use CCERs.
Full-process supervision of emissions data; emitters and verifiers bear responsibility; '严厉打击弄虚作假行为' (crack down hard on falsification).

claim_hooks: bù trừ bằng tín chỉ CCER / offset with CCER credits
tín chỉ được quốc tế công nhận / internationally recognised credits
trung hòa các-bon / carbon neutral
items.evidence_note: gov.cn page opened: title, the date printed in text '2025年5月24日', publication 25 Aug 2025, and the quoted target and enforcement sentences.
items.relevance_why: This is the direction of travel for VN's largest trading partner's carbon market. Indirect relevance to VN claims through exports and Chinese-owned facilities.
items.caveats: Policy document, with no article-level obligations on companies.

items.title: 温室气体自愿减排交易管理办法（试行）
items.title_vi: Biện pháp quản lý giao dịch giảm phát thải KNK tự nguyện (CCER), Trung Quốc
items.authority: 生态环境部 (Ministry of Ecology and Environment), with market regulator

key_dates.what: MEE/MWR notice 环办气候函〔2025〕438号 issues methodology CCER-14-005-V01 (check-dam carbon sink) under these Measures

items.status_note: In force: cited as the legal basis for CCER methodologies issued in Nov 2025. The issue date and order number are not confirmed here and are intentionally left empty.

key_provisions.summary: CCER projects must follow MEE-published methodologies (e.g., CCER-14-005-V01, Nov 2025). New methodologies were added through 2025, including the first oil and gas methodologies (secondary).

claim_hooks: tín chỉ CCER / CCER credits
tín chỉ các-bon tự nguyện / voluntary carbon credits
dự án hấp thụ carbon / carbon sink project
items.evidence_note: Only existence and in-force status are verified: the MEE notice 环办气候函〔2025〕438号 (signed 25 Nov 2025) states it was made '根据《温室气体自愿减排交易管理办法（试行）》'. The Measures' own date and order number were not opened.
items.relevance_why: Rare in VN reports. Useful only if a VN or Chinese-invested company claims offsets with Chinese credits.
items.caveats: Fill issued_date and document_number only after opening the mee.gov.cn rule page.

items.title: Environmental, Social and Governance Reporting Code — Part D Climate-related Disclosures (New Climate Requirements), Main Board Listing Rules
items.title_vi: Quy định công bố thông tin khí hậu mới của HKEX (Phần D Bộ quy tắc ESG)
items.authority: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX)

key_dates.what: HKEX publishes consultation conclusions
FY commencing on or after: Scope 1 and 2 mandatory for all issuers; other New Climate Requirements comply-or-explain for Main Board; voluntary for GEM
FY commencing on or after: LargeCap issuers (Hang Seng Composite LargeCap Index) must comply with all New Climate Requirements, incl. Scope 3
Expected: HKSRS-based reporting for listed publicly accountable entities after a 2027 HKEX consultation

items.status_note: Phased. HKEX plans a 2027 review including whether to mandate assurance. No assurance is currently required (IFRS HK profile, 12 Jun 2025).

key_provisions.summary: Climate disclosures based on IFRS S2, placed in Part D. Parts B and C hold the other ESG requirements. The ESG report is published at the same time as the annual report.
Additional disclosures must not obscure material information.

claim_hooks: phát thải phạm vi 3 / Scope 3 emissions
tuân thủ hoặc giải trình / comply or explain
kế hoạch chuyển đổi khí hậu / climate transition plan

public_data.name: HKEXnews
public_data.what: ESG reports of HK-listed groups with VN operations (Scope 1-2 from FY2025)

items.evidence_note: HKEX release 19 Apr 2024 opened: 'The amended Listing Rules will come into effect on 1 January 2025'; LargeCap mandatory from 1 Jan 2026; comply-or-explain and GEM voluntary. The IFRS HK profile adds that all issuers must disclose Scope 1 and 2 from FY2025, Part D placement, and the assurance position.
items.relevance_why: HK and Chinese groups with VN plants (textiles, footwear, electronics, energy) publish Scope 1-2 that should include VN sites. This allows parent-subsidiary consistency checks.
items.caveats: The rule text itself (Appendix C2) was not opened. The Scope 1-2 'all issuers' fact comes from the IFRS profile.

items.title: Roadmap on Sustainability Disclosure in Hong Kong; HKFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards (HKFRS S1, HKFRS S2)
items.title_vi: Lộ trình công bố thông tin bền vững của Hong Kong và bộ chuẩn mực HKSRS (tương đương ISSB)
items.authority: Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau (FSTB); Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants (HKICPA)

key_dates.what: HKSRS effective date for voluntary application
Expected mandatory HKSRS reporting for listed PAEs (subject to a 2027 HKEX consultation); large non-listed financial institutions no later than 2028

items.status_note: Roadmap launched December 2024 (exact day not confirmed). HKSRS is fully aligned with ISSB and voluntary since 1 Aug 2025. Source: IFRS HK profile dated 12 Jun 2025.

key_provisions.summary: All publicly accountable entities to report under ISSB; large PAEs apply no later than 2028.

claim_hooks: theo HKFRS S1/S2 / in accordance with HKFRS S1 and S2
items.evidence_note: IFRS HK profile (updated 12 Jun 2025) text-extracted. FSTB and HKICPA pages were not opened.
items.relevance_why: Context for HK parents. No direct obligation in VN.
items.caveats: May be outdated after June 2025.

items.title: ESG Disclosure to be Required from 2028 for KOSPI-listed Companies with KRW10 Trillion or More in Total Consolidated Assets (FSC press release)
items.title_vi: Hàn Quốc chốt lộ trình công bố ESG bắt buộc từ 2028 (FSC, 08/07/2026)
items.authority: Financial Services Commission (FSC), after a government–Democratic Party consultative meeting

key_dates.what: 2028 (FY2027 data): ESG disclosure in mandatory business reports for KOSPI companies with consolidated assets of KRW10tn or more (~291 companies incl. affiliates)
2029: threshold falls to KRW5tn or more (~3,171 companies incl. affiliates)
2030: third-party assurance required via FSCMA revision; authorities consider a KRW2tn threshold
Scope 3 required for the KRW10tn tier (KRW5tn: 2032; KRW2tn: expected 2033)

items.status_note: Final government roadmap. The legal basis requires an FSCMA revision bill, which was to be drafted 'as early as in July this year'. Not confirmed as passed by 2026-10-13. Standards are KSSB's, but whether the final KSDS have been issued is not confirmed (the IFRS KR snapshot of 12 Jun 2025 shows exposure drafts only, consultation closed 31 Aug 2024).

implements: KSSB Korean Sustainability Disclosure Standards (KSSB 1, KSSB 2, KSSB 101 — exposure drafts 2024)

key_provisions.summary: For the first three years, exemption from FSCMA damages, administrative sanctions and criminal punishment for sustainability disclosures, but authorities will 'strictly deal with intentional greenwashing activities'. After that, a safe harbour covers forward-looking estimates, GHG estimates and third-party data filed 'faithfully with reasonable grounds and best judgement'.
Deferred three years per tier. SMEs that are not high-carbon emitters are exempt.
In the first year, affiliates below 10% of consolidated assets and sales may be excluded.

claim_hooks: greenwashing cố ý / intentional greenwashing
ước tính phát thải KNK / GHG emission estimates
dữ liệu từ đối tác/bên thứ ba / third-party or partner data
phát thải phạm vi 3 / Scope 3 emissions

public_data.name: DART (FSS electronic disclosure)
public_data.what: Business reports and sustainability disclosures of Korean parents (Samsung, LG, Hyosung, POSCO, Lotte…) with VN subsidiaries

items.evidence_note: FSC English release 87276 (8 Jul 2026) opened. The thresholds, years, Scope 3 deferral, assurance from 2030, 3-year liability exemption with the greenwashing carve-out, safe harbour and affiliate relief were all read there. Release 83138 records the Korea–Viet Nam Financial Cooperation Forum (Hanoi, 25 Sep 2024, with SBV and SSC) on ESG disclosure and the K-taxonomy.
items.relevance_why: Korean groups are the largest FDI source in VN. Their VN subsidiaries feed consolidated ESG data and Scope 3 requests. The roadmap's distinction between honest estimates (safe harbour) and intentional greenwashing (sanctioned) maps onto GreenScan's 'insufficient evidence' versus 'misleading' labels.
items.caveats: This is a press release, not law. Check FSCMA amendment progress and the KSSB final standards before binding.

items.title: 표시·광고의 공정화에 관한 법률 (Act on Fair Labeling and Advertising) and KFTC Guidelines for examination on labeling and advertising of environmental facts
items.title_vi: Luật Ghi nhãn và Quảng cáo công bằng của Hàn Quốc và hướng dẫn thẩm tra tuyên bố môi trường (KFTC)
items.authority: Korea Fair Trade Commission (KFTC)
items.status_note: In force (KFTC policy page checked 2026-10-13). Enactment and amendment dates of the Act and the environmental guidelines were not confirmed.

key_provisions.summary: Four types: (1) false or exaggerated, (2) deceptive (concealing or whitewashing facts), (3) unfairly comparative, (4) slanderous.

Corrective orders, orders to publish the fact of correction, penalty surcharges (the KFTC page states 'up to the amount of sales multiplied by 2% or 500 million won'), criminal referral, and temporary suspension of an ad.
Apply where a business 'labels or advertises any fact concerning an environmental issue', covering materials, ingredients, quality, performance, manufacturing process, price and warranty.

claim_hooks: thân thiện môi trường / eco-friendly (친환경)
phân hủy sinh học / biodegradable
không chứa chất độc hại / free of harmful substances
xanh hơn đối thủ / greener than competitors
items.evidence_note: KFTC English policy page key=557 opened. It confirms the four types, the sanctions and the quoted surcharge wording, and names the environmental-facts guidelines. The Korean title of the Act is given from prior knowledge and was not shown on the page.
items.relevance_why: The four-way typology (false or exaggerated / deceptive omission / unfair comparison / disparagement) closely mirrors VN Luật Quảng cáo Đ.8.9-8.11 and is a good cross-jurisdiction label convention for consumer-facing claims in VN reports.
items.caveats: Korean-language guideline title and amendment dates not verified. The surcharge cap wording is quoted from the KFTC page and should be checked against the current statute.

items.title: 환경기술 및 환경산업 지원법
items.title_vi: Luật Hỗ trợ công nghệ và công nghiệp môi trường Hàn Quốc (điều khoản chống tẩy xanh)
items.authority: Ministry of Environment, Korea (now 기후에너지환경부 per redirected English site mcee.go.kr; not confirmed)
items.status_note: Lead only. The Act exists (law.go.kr title resolved), but its environmental-labelling/advertising (greenwashing) articles, fine amounts and any 2024 amendment could not be opened.
claim_hooks: thân thiện môi trường / eco-friendly (친환경)
items.evidence_note: The law.go.kr page returned only the title. The mcee.go.kr English press list has nothing on greenwashing.
items.relevance_why: Korea is one of the few Asian jurisdictions with a statute-level environmental-claims regime and published case counts. Worth confirming for the case corpus.
items.caveats: Do not cite any article number or fine until opened.

items.title: National Sustainability Reporting Framework (NSRF); Bursa Malaysia Main Market and ACE Market Listing Requirements amendments (sustainability statement per IFRS S1/S2)
items.title_vi: Khung báo cáo bền vững quốc gia Malaysia (NSRF) và sửa đổi quy định niêm yết Bursa
items.authority: Advisory Committee on Sustainability Reporting (ACSR, chaired by Securities Commission Malaysia); Bursa Malaysia

key_dates.what: Bursa amends Main LR and ACE LR to require a sustainability statement per IFRS S1/S2
Group 1 (Main Market, market cap of MYR2bn or more): climate-first reporting for periods beginning on or after this date
Group 2 (other Main Market issuers): climate-first
Group 1 full IFRS S1/S2; Group 3 (ACE Market and large non-listed companies with revenue of MYR2bn or more) climate-first; aim: reasonable assurance of Scope 1-2 for Group 1
Group 2 full IFRS S1/S2
Group 3 full IFRS S1/S2

items.status_note: Per the IFRS MY profile (12 Jun 2025). The SC NSRF page (checked 2026-10-13) lists no deferral, but its implementation sub-page did not render. The assurance framework is still being developed by the SAWG.

key_provisions.summary: Climate-only relief extended by one year (Groups 1 and 2) or two years (Group 3). Scope 3 may be omitted for the first two years (Groups 1 and 2) or three years (Group 3). Reporting must be at the same time as the financial statements (IFRS S1 E4 relief removed).
Temporary relief allows climate disclosures to focus on principal business segments, but the reporting entity must remain the same as the financial statements (SC FAQ).

claim_hooks: báo cáo theo IFRS S2 / climate-first reporting under IFRS S2
phát thải phạm vi 3 / Scope 3
đảm bảo hợp lý phạm vi 1-2 / reasonable assurance of Scope 1 and 2
items.evidence_note: IFRS MY profile (updated 12 Jun 2025) text-extracted: NSRF released 24 Sep 2024, Bursa LR amended 23 Dec 2024, groups and dates, reliefs, and the assurance aim. The SC NSRF page confirms ISSB as baseline, Scope 3 relief and that the assurance framework is pending. The Bursa LR text was not opened.
items.relevance_why: Malaysian groups invest in VN (e.g., banking, energy, real estate). The ASEAN peer closest in design gives a benchmark for what 'ISSB-aligned' means in a neighbouring market.
items.caveats: Check for any 2025-2026 SC/Bursa deferral before binding.

items.title: ACSR sets out approach for non-compliance to sustainability reporting requirements
items.title_vi: Malaysia công bố cách xử lý vi phạm yêu cầu báo cáo bền vững (08/12/2025)
items.authority: Advisory Committee on Sustainability Reporting (ACSR) / Securities Commission Malaysia
items.status_note: Supervisory policy statement. No fines are set in it.

key_provisions.summary: Phased, practical review during the transition. General non-compliance is met with engagement and corrective action, and failure to correct may lead to enforcement. 'Fraudulent and/or misleading material disclosures/omissions' are treated as willful or serious non-compliance for which 'enforcement action remains an essential safeguard'.

claim_hooks: công bố gây hiểu nhầm hoặc bỏ sót trọng yếu / misleading material disclosures or omissions
items.evidence_note: SC media release opened: date 8 Dec 2025 and the quoted phrases.
items.relevance_why: A clear regulator statement separating good-faith transition gaps (engagement) from misleading disclosure (enforcement). This is the same split GreenScan uses between 'insufficient evidence' and 'contradiction or misleading'.

items.document_number: SEC Memorandum Circular No. 16, Series of 2025
items.title: SEC Memorandum Circular No. 16, Series of 2025 (adoption of Philippine Financial Reporting Standards on sustainability disclosures — PFRS S1 and PFRS S2)
items.title_vi: Thông tư số 16/2025 của SEC Philippines: áp dụng PFRS S1/S2 (tương đương ISSB) theo tầng
items.authority: Securities and Exchange Commission, Philippines

key_dates.what: Tier 1: PSE-listed with market cap above PHP50bn, FY beginning on or after
Tier 2: PSE-listed above PHP3bn up to PHP50bn
Tier 3: PSE-listed PHP3bn or less; debt-only PDEx issuers; large non-listed companies with revenue above PHP15bn

items.status_note: Effective 15 days after issuance (date not computed or confirmed). It replaces the 2019 SEC Sustainability Reporting Guidelines (MC No. 4, s. 2019). Limited assurance of Scope 1-2 is required two years after each tier's start.

replaces: SEC MC No. 4, s. 2019 (Sustainability Reporting Guidelines)

key_provisions.summary: Scope 3 omission allowed for two years from each tier's start. Tier 3 may report climate-only for two years.
Mandatory external limited assurance of Scope 1 and 2 by an independent practitioner, two years after initial application, for all tiers.

claim_hooks: báo cáo theo PFRS S1/S2 / PFRS S1 and S2
đảm bảo có giới hạn phạm vi 1-2 / limited assurance of Scope 1 and 2
items.evidence_note: IFRS PH profile (updated 10 Jul 2026) text-extracted: MC 16 issued 23 Dec 2025, effective 15 days after issuance, tiers, reliefs and assurance. The SEC Philippines text was not opened.
items.relevance_why: An ASEAN peer that replaced a 2019 SEC guideline with ISSB is analogous to VN's pending replacement of TT 96 Annex IV. Few Philippine groups operate in VN.
items.caveats: The exact circular title was not verified, so the title is descriptive.

items.title: Principle of Thailand Sustainability Disclosure Roadmap regarding International Sustainability Standards (ISSB Roadmap) — public consultation
items.title_vi: Đề xuất lộ trình áp dụng ISSB của SEC Thái Lan (SET50 công bố từ 2027 cho kỳ 2026)

key_dates.what: Consultation closed
Proposed: SET50 constituents disclose in 2027 for FY2026
Proposed: SET100 disclose in 2028 for FY2027
Proposed: all other SET companies disclose in 2030 for FY2029
Proposed: MAI, REITs and infrastructure/property funds disclose in 2031 for FY2030

items.status_note: As of the IFRS TH snapshot (June 2025), SEC Thailand was assessing feedback and planned a further consultation. No later update was verified, so the newest source is June 2025.

key_provisions.summary: Five years of climate-first reporting, permission to report after the financial statements, no Scope 3 requirement, and continued use of non-GHG-Protocol methods. Disclosure in the 56-1 One Report. Limited assurance of GHG proposed.

claim_hooks: báo cáo One Report 56-1 / 56-1 One Report
phát thải KNK đã được đảm bảo / assured GHG emissions

public_data.name: SET listed company information
public_data.what: 56-1 One Reports of Thai groups with VN subsidiaries (e.g., cement/building materials, beverages, retail)

items.evidence_note: IFRS TH snapshot (updated June 2025) text-extracted. The SEC Thailand consultation paper was not opened.
items.relevance_why: Thai groups are large in VN cement, building materials, beverages and retail. Their parents' disclosures (from FY2026 if adopted) can be compared with VN subsidiary claims.
items.caveats: Possibly outdated. Confirm whether SEC Thailand issued final rules in 2025-2026.

items.title: Standar Pengungkapan Keberlanjutan (PSPK 1 and PSPK 2) and OJK draft regulation on the implementation of sustainable finance for financial sector business entities, issuers and public companies
items.title_vi: Indonesia: chuẩn mực công bố bền vững PSPK 1-2 (01/07/2025) và dự thảo quy định OJK bắt buộc báo cáo theo SPK

OJK consultation opens on a regulation requiring certain companies to report under SPK
OJK consultation closed

claim_hooks: báo cáo bền vững theo SPK / sustainability report under SPK

public_data.name: IDX disclosures
public_data.what: Indonesian peers' sustainability reports (coal, palm oil, cement, nickel)

items.relevance_why: ASEAN peer context, and Indonesian sector peers (coal, cement) for benchmarks.

items.title: IDXCarbon — Bursa Karbon Indonesia
items.title_vi: Sàn giao dịch carbon Indonesia (IDXCarbon) — đối chiếu với sàn carbon HNX của Việt Nam

items.status_note: Operating as of 2026-10-13. Legal basis per site: Government Regulation (PP) 98/2021 on carbon pricing. Launch date not confirmed.

Daily and monthly data. Homepage counters on 2026-10-13: 10 SPE-GRK projects, 159 participants, 1.9 Mt CO2e+ traded, IDR 93.8 bn+ value.

chứng chỉ giảm phát thải SPE-GRK / SPE-GRK certificates

public_data.name: IDXCarbon data daily/monthly
public_data.what: Verifies whether credits cited by Indonesian or regional companies were traded and retired; design reference for what VN's HNX carbon exchange (NĐ 29/2026) should publish

items.evidence_note: IDXCarbon homepage opened 2026-10-13: legal basis sentence (PP 98/2021), OJK supervision, the two markets and the counters.
items.relevance_why: Comparator for VN's new exchange and for offset claims involving ASEAN credits.

items.title: 公開發行公司年報應行記載事項準則 (Regulations Governing Information to be Published in Annual Reports of Public Companies) — amendment of 7 Nov 2025; FSC endorsement of IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 (12 Nov 2025)
items.title_vi: Đài Loan: bắt buộc công bố theo IFRS S1/S2 trong báo cáo thường niên từ năm tài chính 2026 (sửa đổi 07/11/2025)

public_data.what: Annual and sustainability reports of Taiwanese parents of VN steel (Formosa Ha Tinh shareholders), footwear and textile plants. FY2026 IFRS S2 data must cover consolidated VN subsidiaries

items.evidence_note: IFRS Chinese Taipei profile (updated 18 Jun 2026) text-extracted: amendment of 7 Nov 2025, endorsement and letter of 12 Nov 2025, phases and assurance. FSC/SFB pages were not opened.
items.relevance_why: Taiwanese capital is concentrated in VN steel, footwear, textiles and electronics, all high-claim sectors. Parent IFRS S2 numbers from FY2026 give an external cross-check for VN subsidiary emissions claims.
items.caveats: The Chinese title is given from prior knowledge, not shown in the profile. Verify on the FSC site. Taiwan's carbon fee (2025-) was not researched.

items.title: ASEAN Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance Version 4
items.title_vi: Bộ phân loại tài chính bền vững ASEAN phiên bản 4
items.authority: ASEAN Taxonomy Board (published via ASEAN Capital Markets Forum website)

key_dates.what: Version 3 finalised ('takes effect on 20 December 2024')
Version 4 published: completes all six focus and three enabling sectors of the Plus Standard

items.status_note: Voluntary, multi-tier regional taxonomy. Version 4 supersedes Version 3 as the latest edition. The existing team brief mentions v3; v4 is newer.

key_provisions.summary: Completes technical criteria for all six focus sectors and three enabling sectors under the Plus Standard. Aligned with the EU, Singapore-Asia and Indonesia taxonomies (per ACMF page).

claim_hooks: phù hợp Bộ phân loại xanh ASEAN / aligned with the ASEAN Taxonomy
dự án xanh / green project
tín dụng xanh / green lending
trái phiếu xanh / green bond

public_data.name: ASEAN Taxonomy v4 PDF
public_data.what: Activity-level criteria to test 'green project' and 'taxonomy-aligned' claims alongside VN QĐ 21/2025

items.evidence_note: ACMF v4 page opened: 'November 06, 2025' and the 'completes all six focus and three enabling sectors' sentence. ACMF v3 page: 'December 20, 2024' and 'takes effect on 20 December 2024'. The PDFs were not downloaded.
items.relevance_why: VN banks and issuers cite regional alignment for green credit and bonds. Testing a claim needs both VN QĐ 21/2025 (legal) and ASEAN v4 (regional, voluntary) criteria. A mismatch is a context flag, not a violation.
items.caveats: The traffic-light tiers and coal phase-out criteria of the Foundation/Plus frameworks were not verified in this pass. Read the PDF before encoding thresholds.

items.title: ASEAN Simplified ESG Disclosure Guide (ASEDG) for SMEs in Supply Chains (Version 2)
items.title_vi: Hướng dẫn công bố ESG đơn giản hóa của ASEAN cho doanh nghiệp nhỏ và vừa trong chuỗi cung ứng (phiên bản 2)
items.authority: ASEAN Capital Markets Forum (ACMF)

key_dates.what: Version 2 after a five-month consultation

items.status_note: Voluntary guidance. Version 1 was released in April 2025 (day not stated on the ACMF page).

replaces: ASEAN Simplified ESG Disclosure Guide Version 1 (April 2025)

key_provisions.summary: Simplified ESG disclosures so SMEs in supply chains can answer buyers' and lenders' data requests in a way aligned with global standards.

claim_hooks: doanh nghiệp nhỏ và vừa công bố ESG / SME ESG disclosure
đáp ứng yêu cầu của khách hàng toàn cầu / meets global buyer requirements

public_data.name: ASEDG PDF
public_data.what: Baseline indicator set for what an SME supplier report should contain

items.evidence_note: ACMF page opened: 'November 06, 2025', Version 2 after the April 2025 Version 1 and a five-month consultation.
items.relevance_why: Many VN exporters (textiles, footwear, electronics) are SME suppliers. The guide gives a regional 'expected indicator' baseline for their ESG claims.
items.caveats: The V1 date is month-only (April 2025).

items.title: ACMF Voluntary Carbon Market Development Plan
items.title_vi: Kế hoạch phát triển thị trường carbon tự nguyện của ACMF (ASEAN)
items.authority: ASEAN Capital Markets Forum (ACMF), with ERIA

key_dates.what: Posted on ACMF site (PDF filename says 3 Nov); part of the ACMF Action Plan 2026-2030

items.status_note: Policy plan, not binding. No 'ASEAN Common Carbon Framework' instrument was found. This is the closest verified regional carbon-market document.

key_provisions.summary: Build transparent, high-integrity carbon markets in ASEAN and promote interoperability between voluntary and compliance markets.

claim_hooks: tín chỉ các-bon chất lượng cao / high-integrity carbon credits
trung hòa các-bon nhờ bù trừ / carbon neutral via offsets
items.evidence_note: ACMF page opened: posting date and purpose statement. The PDF was not read.
items.relevance_why: Regional context for offset-based neutrality claims. Read the PDF for integrity criteria before use.

items.title: SEBI Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) Core — assurance/assessment and value-chain disclosure requirements (LODR Regulation 34(2)(f) and circulars)
items.title_vi: Ấn Độ: BRSR Core — yêu cầu đảm bảo/đánh giá và công bố chuỗi giá trị (SEBI)
items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
items.status_note: Lead only. 2025 changes (e.g., 'assessment or assurance' wording and value-chain deferral) could not be verified. The first page of the SEBI circular listing (to Oct 2026) has no BRSR circular.
claim_hooks: chỉ số BRSR Core được đảm bảo / BRSR Core assured KPIs
items.evidence_note: Checked https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0 on 2026-10-13: 25 most recent circulars, none on BRSR. Regulation 34(2)(f) is cited from prior knowledge, not verified.
items.relevance_why: Indian groups have limited VN footprint. Mainly a benchmark for KPI-level assurance design.
items.caveats: Do not cite until the SEBI circular is opened.

items.title: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing or Misleading Environmental Claims (Central Consumer Protection Authority)
items.title_vi: Ấn Độ: Hướng dẫn phòng ngừa và quản lý tẩy xanh / tuyên bố môi trường gây hiểu nhầm (CCPA)
items.authority: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), Department of Consumer Affairs, India
items.status_note: Lead only. From prior knowledge, guidelines with this subject were notified by CCPA in 2024. The date, title wording and provisions could not be opened (doca.gov.in TLS error; consumeraffairs.nic.in refused connection).
claim_hooks: thân thiện môi trường / eco-friendly
xanh / green
trung hòa các-bon / carbon neutral
tự nhiên / natural
items.evidence_note: No page opened successfully.
items.relevance_why: If confirmed, this is the only Asian instrument specifically defining greenwashing with substantiation and disclosure rules for generic terms. A useful label-convention source next to EU 2024/825.
items.caveats: High-value lead. Verify date, number and clauses before any use.
